resultsType.title: Content to scrape
resultsType.description:
**Posts** returns a feed of content. **Profile, hashtag, or place details** returns metadata about the page: follower count, bio, post count, and profile picture.

Comments only work with post URLs, e.g. `instagram.com/p/ABC123xyz/` not `instagram.com/username/`.

directUrls.title: Instagram URLs based on content type
directUrls.description:
Add one or more Instagram URLs to scrape.

URL format must match your content type:
  • /p/ for posts and comments
  • /reel/ for reels
  • /username/ for profile details

Leave blank if using the search query instead.

resultsLimit.title: Results limit per URL
resultsLimit.description:
Set how many posts or comments to scrape per Instagram URL. Higher values increase compute usage and cost.

⚠️ Free usage gets only the top 15 comments, sorted by newest, and around 21 mentions. Upgrade to Starter plan for full access.

Use `1` to retrieve a single post per page.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Filter by date
onlyPostsNewerThan.description:
Limit how far back to scrape. Enter a date in `YYYY-MM-DD`, ISO format, or as a relative value, e.g. `1 day`, `2 months`, `3 years`.

Times are in UTC, not local time. New York is UTC-5 in winter, UTC-4 in summer. Pinned posts may still appear even with this filter set.

search.title: Search query
search.description:
Search for Instagram hashtags, profiles, or places.
Use `#` for hashtags, e.g. `#travel`.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: Hashtag search returns posts tagged with that term. Profile search returns matching accounts. Place search returns matching locations.

searchLimit.title: Search results limit
searchLimit.description:
Set how many profiles, places, or hashtags to find.
To limit posts per result, use Results limit per URL.
Higher values increase compute usage and cost.

addParentData.title: Add metadata
addParentData.description: This applies only to feed items. Adds a dataSource field to each result: profile posts are labeled `profile`, and tag posts are labeled `hashtag`.

title: Bilibili (哔哩哔哩) Video Scraper ✅ NO COOKIES

video-scraped.eventDescription: Charged per video returned by keyword search.

video-detail-scraped.eventDescription: Charged per full video detail (stats, owner, parts, cid).

comment-scraped.eventDescription: Charged per comment returned (min 2 per video).

danmaku-scraped.eventDescription: Charged per video whose danmaku (bullet-comments) are returned.

transcript-scraped.eventDescription: Charged per video whose native transcript is returned.

trend-scraped.eventDescription: Charged per trending video or hot-search term returned (min 2).

searchType.title: 🎯 What to scrape (mode) / 抓取模式
searchType.description: Choose the mode. EVERY mode is paid: the run is billed per result by the mode you pick here (price shown in each option below). Each mode uses a different input field and is billed as its own event; failed lookups are free, Gold+ Apify plans get 20% off. // 请选择模式。所有模式均按结果计费，价格见下方各选项。不同模式使用下方不同的输入字段并按各自事件计费；查询失败不收费，Gold 及以上套餐享 8 折。

keywords.title: 🔍 Keywords / 关键词
keywords.description: Used by "Keyword search" ($0.01 per video returned). One or more search terms, e.g. "编程" (programming), "游戏" (games). // 用于「关键词搜索」（每返回一个视频 $0.01），可填写一个或多个关键词。

sortOrder.title: ↕️ Sort order / 排序
sortOrder.description: Only for "Keyword search". How to sort results. // 仅用于「关键词搜索」，结果排序方式。

durationFilter.title: ⏱️ Video length / 时长筛选
durationFilter.description: Only for "Keyword search". Filter results by video length. Free. // 仅用于「关键词搜索」，按视频时长筛选，免费。

publishedAfter.title: 📅 Published on/after / 发布起始日期
publishedAfter.description: Only for "Keyword search". Return only videos published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Free. // 仅用于「关键词搜索」，仅返回该日期（含）之后发布的视频，格式 YYYY-MM-DD，免费。

publishedBefore.title: 📅 Published on/before / 发布结束日期
publishedBefore.description: Only for "Keyword search". Return only videos published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Free. // 仅用于「关键词搜索」，仅返回该日期（含）之前发布的视频，格式 YYYY-MM-DD，免费。

videoUrls.title: 🔗 Video URLs or BV IDs / 视频链接或BV号
videoUrls.description: Used by "Video detail" ($0.02/video), "Comments" ($0.008/comment, min 2), "Danmaku" ($0.01/video), and "Transcript" ($0.01/video). Paste video URLs (https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV...) or bare BV IDs (BV1rpWjevEip). // 用于「视频详情」（$0.02/条）「评论」（$0.008/条，最低 2 条）「弹幕」（$0.01/视频）「字幕」（$0.01/视频），可粘贴视频链接或BV号。

userUrls.title: 👤 UP主 space URLs or UIDs / UP主主页链接或UID
userUrls.description: Used by "UP主 profile" ($0.012 per user) and "UP主 videos" ($0.01 per video returned). Paste space URLs (https://space.bilibili.com/178360345) or bare numeric UIDs. // 用于「UP主主页」（每个用户 $0.012）和「UP主投稿视频」（每返回一个视频 $0.01），可粘贴主页链接或纯数字UID。

trendType.title: 📈 Trending type / 热门类型
trendType.description: Only for "Trending" ($0.008 per result, min 2). Return trending videos (热门视频) or hot search terms (热搜词). // 仅用于「热门」（$0.008/条，每次最低 2 条），返回热门视频或热搜关键词。

maxItems.title: 💯 Max results per keyword/target / 每个关键词或目标的最大结果数
maxItems.description: How many results to return per keyword or target for list modes (search, comments, UP主 videos, trending). ⚠️ This is your main cost lever: those modes bill per result, so total cost ≈ mode price × results (up to this cap) × targets. Video detail / profile return one record per target; danmaku and transcript return the full set from a single call. Comments and Trending bill a minimum of 2 results per request. Why there is a minimum: one request is one lookup, and that lookup does the same work whether it comes back with 50 results, with 1, or with none. The minimum covers the request itself, which is what keeps thin targets worth running instead of being refused outright. Requests that fail are free. // 每个关键词或目标返回的最大结果数（搜索/评论/UP主投稿/热门）。⚠️ 这是主要的费用控制项：上述模式按结果计费，总费用≈模式单价×结果数（不超过此上限）×目标数。视频详情/主页每个目标一条；弹幕与字幕按单次调用返回全部。 「评论」与「热门/热搜」每次请求最低计费 2 条。为什么有最低计费：一次请求就是一次查询，无论返回 50 条、1 条还是 0 条，工作量都相同。最低计费覆盖的是这次请求本身，这样结果很少的目标依然值得抓取，而不是被直接拒绝。请求失败不收费。

includeReplies.title: 💬 Also fetch full reply threads ($) / 同时抓取完整楼中楼
includeReplies.description: Only for "Video comments". Off by default, each top-level comment still ships up to 3 reply previews for free. Turn ON to also fetch every reply (楼中楼) in each thread. Each reply is a comment, so it is billed as one comment ($0.008), and "Max results" caps the total (comments + replies). // 仅用于「视频评论」。默认关闭，每条评论仍免费附带最多 3 条楼中楼预览；开启后抓取每条评论下的全部楼中楼。回复即评论，按评论计费（$0.008/条），「最大结果数」限制总量（评论+回复）。

title: RedNote Xiaohongshu (小红书) Scraper ✅ NO COOKIES

post-scraped.eventDescription: One RedNote/Xiaohongshu note from keyword search or a user's posts (title, stats, author, images, hashtags).

post-detail.eventDescription: Full detail for one image note (body text, stats, all images, hashtags, topics, IP location).

video.eventDescription: Full detail for one video note, including the playable video URL.

profile.eventDescription: One user profile (nickname, RED ID, bio, fans, follows, note count, verification).

comment.eventDescription: One comment on a note (text, likes, author, replies). Minimum 2 per note.

product.eventDescription: One product from product search (title, price, vendor, image, link).

trend.eventDescription: One entry from the RedNote hot list (rank, topic, hot value). Minimum 2 per run.

influencer.eventDescription: One influencer record from 蒲公英/PGY: rate card (picture/video price), fans, level, tags, 30-day growth.

searchType.title: 🎯 What to scrape (mode) / 抓取模式
searchType.description: Choose the mode. 💲 Each mode is its own PAID event: the price is shown on every option below. Then fill ONLY the section marked with the same mode. // 选择模式。💲 每种模式为独立的付费事件，价格已标注在下方每个选项上；然后只填写标有相同模式的分区。

keywords.title: 🔍 Keywords ($) / 关键词
keywords.description: 💲 Paid per result of the selected mode: keyword search $0.02/note, product search $0.04/product. One or more terms, e.g. "护肤" (skincare), "口红" (lipstick). // 💲 按所选模式的结果计费：关键词搜索 $0.02/条，商品搜索 $0.04/个。可填写一个或多个关键词。

noteType.title: 🎬 Note type, free / 笔记类型筛选（免费）
noteType.description: Only for "Keyword search". FREE: restrict results to a note type, no extra charge. // 仅用于「关键词搜索」，免费，按笔记类型筛选，不额外计费。

timeFilter.title: 🕒 Time filter, free / 发布时间筛选（免费）
timeFilter.description: Only for "Keyword search". FREE: restrict results by publish time, no extra charge. // 仅用于「关键词搜索」，免费，按发布时间筛选，不额外计费。

sortType.title: ↕️ Sort by, free / 排序方式（免费）
sortType.description: Only for "Keyword search". FREE: order the results. "Most liked" is the way to get the highest-engagement notes first. // 仅用于「关键词搜索」，免费，对结果排序。「最热」可优先获取高互动笔记。

noteUrls.title: 🔗 Note URLs or IDs ($) / 笔记链接或ID
noteUrls.description: 💲 Paid per selected mode: note detail $0.04/note, comments $0.01/comment (min 2 per note). Paste full note URLs (https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/...), app share links (http://xhslink.com/... - just paste as-is, resolved automatically), or bare 24-character note IDs. // 💲 按所选模式计费：笔记详情 $0.04/条，评论 $0.01/条（每条笔记最低2）。可粘贴完整笔记链接、App分享短链接（http://xhslink.com/... 直接粘贴即可，自动解析）或24位笔记ID。

maxComments.title: 💬 Max comments per note ($0.01/comment) / 每条笔记最大评论数
maxComments.description: For "Note comments" mode and the "Also fetch comments" add-on. 💲 Each comment returned is billed comment ($0.01, min 2 per note). Why there is a minimum: one request is one lookup, and that lookup does the same work whether it comes back with 50 results, with 1, or with none. The minimum covers the request itself, which is what keeps thin targets worth running instead of being refused outright. Requests that fail are free. // 用于「笔记评论」模式及「同时抓取评论」附加项。💲 每返回一条评论按 comment 计费（$0.01，每条笔记最低2）。 为什么有最低计费：一次请求就是一次查询，无论返回 50 条、1 条还是 0 条，工作量都相同。最低计费覆盖的是这次请求本身，这样结果很少的目标依然值得抓取，而不是被直接拒绝。请求失败不收费。

userUrls.title: 👤 Profile URLs or user IDs ($) / 用户主页链接或ID
userUrls.description: 💲 Paid per selected mode: profile $0.04/profile, influencer analytics $0.05/creator. Paste profile URLs (https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/...) or bare 24-character user IDs. // 💲 按所选模式计费：主页 $0.04/个，达人分析 $0.05/个。可粘贴主页链接或24位用户ID。

maxItems.title: 💯 Max results per keyword/target ($) / 每个关键词或目标的最大结果数
maxItems.description: How many results to return per keyword or target for search, product search and trending. 💲 Affects cost: these bill per result, so a higher value costs more. Detail/profile/influencer return one record per target; comments use their own "Max comments per note" below. Trending bills a minimum of 2 rows per request. Why there is a minimum: one request is one lookup, and that lookup does the same work whether it comes back with 50 results, with 1, or with none. The minimum covers the request itself, which is what keeps thin targets worth running instead of being refused outright. Requests that fail are free. // 用于搜索、商品搜索与热榜，每个关键词或目标返回的最大结果数。💲 影响费用：按条计费，数值越大费用越高；详情/主页/达人每个目标一条记录；评论用下方「每条笔记最大评论数」。 「热榜」每次请求最低计费 2 条。为什么有最低计费：一次请求就是一次查询，无论返回 50 条、1 条还是 0 条，工作量都相同。最低计费覆盖的是这次请求本身，这样结果很少的目标依然值得抓取，而不是被直接拒绝。请求失败不收费。

includePosts.title: 📝 Also fetch the user's posts ($) / 同时抓取用户笔记
includePosts.description: For "User profile" only. 💲 PAID add-on: also returns the user's recent posts, billed as post-scraped ($0.02 per post returned) ON TOP of the $0.04 profile charge. Off by default. // 仅用于「用户主页」。💲 付费附加项——在 $0.04 主页费用之外，额外返回用户最近发布的笔记，按 post-scraped 计费（$0.02/条）。默认关闭。

maxPostsPerUser.title: 📝 Max posts per user ($0.02/post) / 每个用户最大笔记数
maxPostsPerUser.description: Only used when "Also fetch the user's posts" is on. 💲 Each post returned is billed post-scraped ($0.02). Set 0 to fetch none. // 仅在启用「同时抓取用户笔记」时生效。💲 每返回一条笔记按 post-scraped 计费（$0.02）。设为 0 则不抓取。

includeComments.title: 💬 Also fetch the note's comments ($) / 同时抓取笔记评论
includeComments.description: For "Note detail" only. 💲 PAID add-on: also returns the note's comments, billed as comment ($0.01/comment, min 2 per note) ON TOP of the $0.04 note-detail charge. Use "Max comments per note" above to cap. Off by default. // 仅用于「笔记详情」。💲 付费附加项——在 $0.04 笔记详情费用之外，额外返回该笔记的评论，按 comment 计费（$0.01/条，每条笔记最低2）。用上方「每条笔记最大评论数」限制数量。默认关闭。
